title: Change the inequality weight
hook: Two stated cases: explore the parameter in an illustrative preference rule.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the parameter in an illustrative preference rule affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Utility, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the parameter in an illustrative preference rule in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy utility equals own payoff 3 minus weight 0.1 times any shortfall below other payoff 7. What is utility?
